FAQ

Can I use a section as a full page?
Yes. Each section is a self-contained block with its own layout, so you compose a landing page from several or drop one into an existing page.
How do I install the components in Sections?
With the shadcn CLI. Each component page lists its exact command: free components install from a public URL (npx shadcn add https://useplanes.com/r/<name>.json), Pro components install by name (npx shadcn add @useplanes/<name>) after npx @useplanes/cli init --key <key>.
Do they work with Next.js App Router and Tailwind CSS v4?
Yes. Every component is a React 19 client component styled with Tailwind CSS v4, and works in Next.js App Router, Vite, or any React app with Tailwind CSS v4.
Are the components in Sections free?
1 of the 32 are free. The rest need a one-time Planes Pro license, which covers every component and future additions.
What do they depend on?
Motion (formerly Framer Motion) is the only runtime animation dependency. The CLI writes the .tsx source into your project, so there is no Planes package to keep updated.
